deviceLogin.bannerTitle: A CLI login is waiting for your approval
deviceLogin.fingerprintHint: The terminal prints the same server fingerprint. If it differs, deny: the CLI is talking to another server.
deviceLogin.expired: This request has expired. Run the login command again.
deviceLogin.ipMismatch: This request came from {{ip}}, which is not the address you are using. Only approve it if you started it.
deviceLogin.confirmTitle: Confirm this code matches your terminal
deviceLogin.confirmBody: Look at the terminal that ran the login command. Approve only if it shows exactly this code.
deviceLogin.agentHint: Only a person signed in here can approve. An AI agent cannot do it for you.
deviceLogin.resolvedExpired: CLI login from {{name}} expired before it was approved
deviceLogin.resolvedMore_one: {{count}} more login needs a look on the Status page.
deviceLogin.resolvedMore_other: {{count}} more logins need a look on the Status page.
deviceLogin.startOverHint: Run this in your terminal to request a new login:
deviceLogin.dismissed: Dismissed. The audit log keeps the record.
deviceLogin.emptyBody: Run levelrail-cli auth login --device in a terminal and the code shows up here.

items.deviceLoginDetail: Expires in {{time}}. Open CLI access to compare the code and approve.
items.deviceExpiredDetail: Nobody approved it in time. Run the login command again if you still need it.
items.deviceDeniedDetail: Someone denied this request. Run the login command again if you still need it.
items.nodeReenrollDetail: Its key was made by the control plane in an early beta. It keeps working until its certificate expires on {{date}}, then it cannot renew.
items.nodeReenrollExpired: Its key was made by the control plane in an early beta. Its certificate expired on {{date}} and it cannot renew.
items.nodeEnrollDetail: Check the agent logs and that it can reach this control plane.
items.tokenExpiringDetail: Expires {{date}}. Anything using it will stop working.
items.tokenExpiredDetail: Expired {{date}}. Requests using it are rejected.
items.dbSecurityTitle_one: {{count}} database has a security update available
items.dbEolTitle: {{name}} runs an end of life version
items.resourceAdviceSummaryDetail: Right-size limits, sleep idle apps or tune databases. Nothing changes until you apply one.
items.invitesDetail: {{pending}} waiting to be accepted, {{expired}} expired without being accepted.
items.loginCodeDetail: {{agent}}. Only show the code if you asked for it.
items.loginApprovalTitle: New browser sign-in from {{ip}} is waiting
items.loginApprovalDetail: {{agent}}. Approve it only if it is you.
items.loginAnomalyDetail: Someone may be guessing passwords. Open the security center.
items.accountFlaggedDetail: A sign-in was reported as not the owner's. Change the password, then review sessions.
items.tokenUnusedDetail: It is disabled on {{date}} unless it is used or revoked first.

channel.notifyDeviceLogin: Notify when a CLI login is waiting
channel.notifyDeviceLoginHint: Sends a link only, never the code. Turn on a dashboard URL so the link can open this page.
channel.notifyDeviceLoginExpired: Notify when a CLI login expires
channel.notifyDeviceLoginExpiredHint: Sends a link only, never the code, when a login request runs out of time unapproved.
channel.interactiveApprovalsWarning: Anyone in this channel, including the person who requested the deploy, can approve a protected deploy from chat. Only a root user can turn this on or change its secret or webhook.

copyFailure.technicalHelp: The raw error with passwords removed. Share it when asking for help.
copyFailure.dismissed: Dismissed. A new failed attempt will show again.

silence.confirmForever: This issue will stay hidden until you unsilence it, even if it gets worse. It stays listed under Silenced.
silence.confirmCritical: This is a critical or security-related issue. Silencing it hides it from the issue count. It stays listed under Silenced.

statusPage.title: Status
statusPage.description: Everything that needs attention right now. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
statusPage.healthyDescription: All systems healthy. No failing apps or deploys, offline nodes, low disk, or expiring certificates.
